section_anchor: The arc: open, close, peak, cooldown
brief_summary: Three small line-chart panels, one per weekly tracker snapshot for GMK CYL TA Neo. W30 panel plots the eight-week pre-close spark trail rising to a close-of-buy peak. W31 panel plots the spark trail rising through most of the week then dropping sharply at the final read, the first cooldown. W32 panel, bordeaux-emphasized as the current/focal read, plots a spark trail declining throughout, the continued cooldown.
